product_metadata.title: GREEN ORANGE Fleece Throw Blanket for Couch – 50x60 for Adult and Kids, Lightweight, Red Dahlia – Soft, Plush, Fluffy, Warm, Cozy – Perfect for Bed, Sofa
features: Stylish Desigh: Our accent blankets and throws feature trendy colors and textures. They will make an excellent decorative element in any home. Add one of these as another layer on your bed or neatly fold it and place on the couch, sofa or chair

High End Quality: These super-soft fleece blankets are made from polyester fibers to ensure superior quality and long-lasting durability. It won’t shed, fade or lose softness wash after wash, year after year. Certified MADE IN GREEN by OEKO-TEX
Perfect For All Seasons: Our waffle design blankets are both warming and breathable. They will warm you up in winter and chilly summer nights. Hence, they are perfect for year-round comfort
Great Gift Idea: These warm blankets for winter could be a perfect present for any occasion - Birthday, Christmas, Housewarming. Remember, it’s a gift that will hold up over the years

Machine Washable: To save the softness and smooth feel of your comfy blanket wash it in cold water on a delicate cycle and hang it up to air dry. Use non-chlorine bleach only. Be sure to check your blanket’s tag
